topic_alignment.paraphrase: Lee turns from two levels to multiple update speeds. He discusses session-local state, file-backed memory and the model's network parameters. By the 3280 s storyboard frame, the session break and all three layers are visible.

Lee names intrinsic motivation, then describes delegating writing, planning and running experiments, and finding a question within a human-specified field. The recording animates the chain from the right; the 3440 s frame also includes an initiating human and example research projects that are absent from the released PDF.

Lee recalls a person telling an agent to strengthen its math. The recorded goal H and model diagram is visible at 3550 s. The earlier math-prompt discussion at 3486.916 s is accompanied by a system-prompt quotation rather than this diagram.

Lee asks whether the agent could want to learn on its own. The 3560 s frame shows the proposing agent, goal H and the references to curiosity and empowerment. He explicitly introduces curiosity at 3600.229 s and empowerment at 3618.514 s.
Lee points to his 2018 machine-learning recording on curiosity. At 3710 s the storyboard shows the full Intrinsic Curiosity Module diagram and the reference to the older lecture.
The link printed on page 60 starts at 9:07. Storyboard frames on either side show the Curiosity slide with a trajectory of state-action transitions, not the later two-network ICM diagram.
The later build of the Curiosity slide shows the intrinsic bonus alongside the environment reward for the same transitions.
The 10:40 frame shows the beginning of the ICM forward-model explanation, using a single Network 1 diagram.

At 14:20 both feature extractors, the forward and inverse models, and the annotation about action-relevant features are visible. This corresponds to the diagram pictured on physical page 60 of the 2026 PDF.
